headline: NYU Shanghai report preserves a Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6 RL dashboard snapshot
summary: A September 17 NYU Shanghai RITS report preserves a contemporaneous view of Xiaomi's public MiMo-V2.6 reinforcement-learning dashboard. It describes two runs, `mimo-v2.6-pro` and `mimo-v2.6-flash`, and reports that the dashboard showed about US$1.23 million cumulative spend, 27.6B and 35.2B processed tokens, long rollout contexts and intermediate DeepSWE scores. The page also showed run restarts associated with a VRAM issue and a dataset infrastructure error. These are dashboard values relayed by RITS, not independently audited telemetry. Xiaomi's dashboard currently renders only navigation labels, so current status and live values could not be checked.
